Now, the reason I didn't get the coffee is because my co-worker received an award. That's a big deal! They probably worked really hard and deserve the recognition. I didn't get the coffee because of the award, but was that the right reason? Maybe I should have still gotten the coffee to show continued support, regardless of the award. The award is a separate event; it doesn't negate the daily gesture of kindness. I also need to think about how this affects our relationship. Maybe I should have still gotten the coffee and then congratulated them on the award separately. That way, I maintain the routine and also acknowledge their achievement.
